column1: # no SD slot where the filesystem carries the web assets and the whole
# Reticulum transport store. The 4 MB table had to take its slots out of the
# filesystem's hide; this one takes them out of room that was going spare.
# App slots are 64 KiB aligned because the bootloader requires it. The
# filesystem partition is named spiffs even though it holds LittleFS:
# LittleFS.begin() looks the partition up by that label
# find fails the mount without formatting anything — the node then runs with no
# filesystem at all while the flash still holds every file.
# A partition table is a one-way door: it can only be changed by writing the
# whole flash over a cable. This board gets the A/B layout from its first
# flash so that door never has to be gone back through.
